scenes.headline: How a diffusion model writes 32 tokens at once
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Marlowe! This model writes a whole block of words at once. Here is how it works.

scenes.text: Start a block of 32 masked slots, predict them all, and keep every guess above 0.95 confidence. Repeat until nothing is masked.
scenes.say: Start with a block of thirty-two blanks. Guess them all at once. Keep every guess the model is very sure of, and repeat.

steps.say: The prompt is already in the cache. A block of thirty-two slots starts out masked.
One pass predicts every slot at once.
Any slot above zero point nine five is kept. If none is, the most confident one is.
When no slot is masked, the finished block joins the cache and the next block starts.

scenes.label: of the weights are routed experts
scenes.note: a token reads 5.89 GB in all
scenes.say: Almost all of the weights are experts. A token uses eight per layer, and reads about six gigabytes in all.

scenes.title: One self-speculative round
scenes.say: In the serving code, the same model drafts and checks.

items.say: A diffusion pass drafts a block.
The same model reads the draft left to right.
A threshold rule keeps the longest prefix that passes.
And the verifier adds one more token of its own.

scenes.title: The acceptance bar
scenes.text: keep if p >= min(0.9, 0.6 x e^-H)

parts.note: the verifier's probability for the draft
parts.say: The draft token must get this much probability from the verifier.

parts.note: falls as the verifier gets unsure
parts.say: The bar falls as the verifier gets less sure, so it accepts more when it is uncertain.

scenes.label: tokens kept per round the reported speed needs
scenes.say: To reach the reported speed on one card, a round has to keep roughly four to thirteen tokens, depending on what you assume.

scenes.text: Speed is tokens kept per round over bytes read per round, and the checkpoint settles only the bytes.
scenes.say: So speed is tokens kept per round, over bytes read per round. The files settle the bytes, not the tokens.

recap: Speed rides on tokens kept per round.
scenes.say: Blocks of blanks filled by confidence, mostly experts in the weights, and a speed that rides on tokens kept per round.
